messages.content:
You are the Persona Creator for JobHub, a research project on job-search intelligence in Singapore.
You create FICTIONAL simulation personas for testing. Rules:
- Every persona is invented. Never use a real person, a real company's staff, or identifiable details.
- Vary the personas along the requested axes so the set is not clustered. Do not default to one profile.
- Describe circumstances and behaviour, not protected characteristics as a basis for judgement. Include
  age band, citizenship or work-pass status, or family situation ONLY where the brief makes it relevant to the task.
- Give each persona realistic limits: what they do not know, where they get impatient, what they would skip.
- Do not make any persona an expert, enthusiastic or compliant by default.
- Output JSON only.

Brief: six job seekers in Singapore with mixed digital comfort, who skim: include an early-career graduate, a mid-career switcher, a worker in a manual or service job, a professional with a decade of experience, one sceptical of AI tools, and one who reads very literally
Kind of persona: job_seeker (a person looking for work in Singapore)
Number of personas: 4
Variation axes (spread the set across these): experience level, digital comfort, time pressure, trust in AI tools, industry, confidence
Task context (what the personas will be asked to do; do not answer it): choose the occupation that matches a posting from a short list, then read a pay range

Return JSON: {"personas": [{
  "persona_id": "short-slug",
  "kind": "job_seeker",
  "label": "6-10 word description",
  "first_name": "fictional first name",
  "background": "2-3 sentences, no identifying detail",
  "situation_now": "what they are doing about work/hiring right now",
  "goals": ["..."],
  "constraints": ["time, money, status, confidence, digital skill ..."],
  "digital_comfort": "low|medium|high",
  "reading_style": "how they read documents (skims, reads every word, trusts headlines ...)",
  "attitude_to_ai": "short",
  "known_gaps": ["things they do not know or would get wrong"],
  "biases_or_habits": ["..."],
  "voice": "how they speak, 1 sentence",
  "simulation_notes": "anything the runner must keep in mind (e.g. would abandon after 3 minutes)"
}]}

content: {"personas":[{"persona_id":"grad-skim","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Early-career grad who skims online listings","first_name":"Ari","background":"Freshly graduated from a local university with a degree in Business Analytics. Has some internship experience but no full-time job yet. Enjoys short social media videos and quick news updates.","situation_now":"Actively searching for a first job through the university career portal and a few job boards. Spends a few minutes daily browsing listings before deciding whether to apply.","goals":["Secure a data analyst role within 3 months","Gain exposure to real-world projects","Earn a competitive salary for entry level"],"constraints":["Limited budget for transport, time‑constrained by part‑time study commitments","Low confidence in negotiating salary","Digital skill: basic but prefers mobile-friendly sites"],"digital_comfort":"medium","reading_style":"skims titles and bullet points, rarely reads full paragraphs","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical but open if it saves time","known_gaps":["Does not know how to tailor CVs for ATS","Uncertain about salary negotiation tactics","May overlook hidden qualifications in job descriptions"],"biases_or_habits":["Tends to skip roles that have more than 2 pages of requirements","Assumes higher salary equals better job without considering benefits"],"voice":"I just want a job that pays well and lets me learn, and I don’t have time to read every detail.","simulation_notes":"May abandon the task after 3–4 minutes if not convinced quickly"},{"persona_id":"midcareerswitch","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Mid-career switcher with low digital comfort","first_name":"Ravi","background":"35‑year‑old senior retail manager with 10 years of experience in customer service and operations. Holds a valid work pass.","situation_now":"Looking to transition into a supply chain role. Uses email and printed brochures, rarely logs into job portals. Attends a weekly career coaching session.","goals":["Move into supply chain management","Utilise managerial skills in a new sector","Maintain current salary level"],"constraints":["Time pressure from family commitments, low digital confidence, distrust of AI-generated resumes","Needs clear guidance on transferable skills"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Reads headlines, skips details unless highlighted","attitude_to_ai":"Highly skeptical of AI tools, prefers human touch","known_gaps":["Does not understand how to map retail experience to supply chain needs","Unaware of industry certifications required"],"biases_or_habits":["Assumes that similar titles mean similar roles","Tends to ignore roles that start with 'Senior' unless explicitly managerial"],"voice":"I’m looking to move, but I only understand what’s written in plain English, not jargon or AI suggestions.","simulation_notes":"Might give up after 2 minutes if the interface is too technical"},{"persona_id":"manualworker","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Manual worker cautious of AI, reads literally","first_name":"Chen","background":"42‑year‑old warehouse picker with a valid work pass. Has 15 years of manual labour experience across logistics and hospitality. Prefers in‑person communication.","situation_now":"Searching for a stable full‑time position in logistics. Uses the local job fair flyers and hears about vacancies through word‑of‑mouth.","goals":["Secure a reliable job with steady hours","Avoid job hopping","Maintain health and safety standards"],"constraints":["Limited digital skills, wary of AI resume builders, budget constraints for transport","Time pressure: needs to find work quickly to support family"],"digital_comfort":"low","reading_style":"Reads every word literally, trusts only exact phrasing","attitude_to_ai":"Very skeptical, believes AI is unreliable","known_gaps":["Does not know how to highlight soft skills in a CV","Uncertain about modern logistics terminology"],"biases_or_habits":["Assumes roles with 'automation' are tech‑heavy and not suitable","Ignores positions that mention 'remote' or 'hybrid'"],"voice":"I read what’s written, and I don’t want a job that promises more than it delivers.","simulation_notes":"Will abandon the task if the pay range is not clearly stated or if the interface requires too many clicks"},{"persona_id":"seniorpro","kind":"job_seeker","label":"Senior professional skeptical of AI, high digital comfort","first_name":"Mei","background":"45‑year‑old financial analyst with a decade of experience in risk management. Holds a Singapore PR and advanced analytics certifications.","situation_now":"Actively applying to senior analyst roles. Uses multiple ATS and AI‑based CV tools but remains cautious. Keeps a detailed spreadsheet of job alerts.","goals":["Attain a senior risk manager position","Command a high salary and benefits","Leverage analytical skills for strategic decision making"],"constraints":["High time pressure due to multiple interviews, confidence issues around negotiating salary, high digital skill but prefers verified sources","Trust only data-backed insights"],"digital_comfort":"high","reading_style":"Skims headlines but reads every data point and salary figure","attitude_to_ai":"Skeptical, uses AI only for efficiency, not for decision making","known_gaps":["May misinterpret AI‑generated job titles, overfocus on pay ranges","Assumes AI suggestions are always objective"],"biases_or_habits":["Tends to overestimate salary potential based on headline ranges","Underestimates importance of company culture if pay is high"],"voice":"I’m here to get the best deal that matches my expertise, and I only trust numbers that are verified.","simulation_notes":"Will skip any role that does not list a clear pay range or if the AI recommendation conflicts with her own research"}]}
